[CR CR1567r2 for 36.321] Reason for change: In NR NTN, there is explicit agreement that “UE reports Full TA (i.e., T_TA as defined in the UE’s TA formula)” which has been reflected in the ta-Report field description in RRC spec and MAC spec. But in IoT NTN, the description for Timing Advance Reporting captures it as UE specific TA which adds confusion on UE reporting full TA or UE specific component of the TA. It should be clarified and aligned with NR NTN. The RTToffset has a variable length, hence an ellipsis is needed in the figures. Summary of change: To clarify in section 5.4.9, the UE’s timing advance reporting is not the UE specific TA. Add an ellipsis in the (UL) HARQ RTT timer figures. Impact Analysis Impacted functionality: TA report and (UL) HARQ RTT timer in IoT NTN Inter-operability: No inter-operability issue is foreseen. Consequences if not approved: For #1 change, if not approved, there may be confusion on enabling of UE specific TA or full TA report.

However, one concern is that if we clarify this only for SDT, then the non-SDT case may remain ambiguous (i.e. it would appear that when T319 is running UE is allowed to reinitiate resume, but we agreed this is not possible and only captured this in chairman’s notes). So, companies can explain if and why we should clarify this only for SDT. | [Apple]: It seems NAS spec has no description to fobbiden this case happen. Then according to current spec, does it mean UE will trigger another procdure (RRCresume/SDT) during the SDT procedure? [CATT] Different from legacy resume procedure, the UE is allowed to send RRC message, i.e. UAI, during SDT before receiving RRC response message from NW. We also support to clarify this a bit more. So, if we clarify this for SDT, we think we should do the same also for legacy resume.
